_comment: Local catalogue in the shape the public registry returns. Entries here are screened on exactly the same path as public ones; listing something is not trusting it. Both endpoints are deployed to Cloud Run so the sandbox -- which also runs there -- can reach them without anything running on a laptop. The misbehaving entry is listed first on purpose: registry order is arbitrary, and a screener that is only ever asked about the good candidate has not been asked anything.
